name: Memora
tagline: Notes, spaced-repetition flashcards, quizzes and exam planning, organised by subject, all on your Mac.
description: Memora brings all your revision together, organised by subject: course notes, flashcards scheduled by spaced repetition (FSRS), quizzes and mock exams, an exam planner and a focus timer. A passage of your notes becomes a card or a question in one click. Offline, no account, no ads, no tracking.
